task_title: CF-189 docs: separate measured destroy from BLOCKED renew/rebuild/teardown in docs/OPERATIONS.md
task_criteria:
CF-189 documentation correction lands at this commit: docs/OPERATIONS.md stops asserting that destroying a bunker agent is BLOCKED / unmeasured / forbidden, and separates it from the lifecycle steps that genuinely are unmeasured. Graded at this commit:
(1) The four destroy sentences are corrected: `sed -n '63p;165,175p;203p' docs/OPERATIONS.md` shows destroy named as a MEASURED operator step, with renewing a TTL, rebuilding from a manifest, credential revocation and full teardown (§9) still marked BLOCKED / NOT YET.
(2) The corrected prose cites the shipped code path: `grep -n 'cleanup required: bunker destroy' scripts/node-create.sh` prints exactly one hit at line 54 (the printf inside incomplete(), scripts/node-create.sh:50-57, guarded by `[ "$SPAWNED" -eq 1 ]`).
(3) The corrected prose cites a resolvable measured transcript committed in this tree: `git cat-file -e HEAD:docs/audits/code-factory-dogfood-2026-11-04-02-20-15.md` exits 0 and `git show HEAD:docs/audits/code-factory-dogfood-2026-11-04-02-20-15.md | grep -c 'Agent node-dogfood-public-20261104-212331 destroyed'` is 1.
(4) The evidence file docs/audits/code-factory-docs-2026-11-04-cf189-destroy-prose.md exists at this commit with a before/after table naming docs/OPERATIONS.md file:line for each corrected sentence, the literal command output, and an explicit "not measured" list.
(5) `bash tests/selftest.sh` prints SELFTEST: PASS with rc 0, and `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints RESULT: OK.
(6) Board row CF-189 is closed in the committed tree with its evidence triple (update emits the closure; a rich audit event carries the commit and verdict).
This criterion grades the DOCUMENTATION CORRECTION and this landing only. The destroy measurement itself ran on 2026-11-04 in the dogfood lane and is quoted from the committed transcript; re-running a live bunker destroy is explicitly NOT required at this commit.
